item.tib: rig 'dzin gsang ba'i rgyud las gshin rje'i tshong zlog ral gri'i 'khor lo
item.coloph: bdag 'dra o rgyan bde chen gling pa mi 'gyur tshe dbang gsang sngags grags pa rtsal gyis kong yul dbus phyogs yongs rdzong dpal gyi phug nas drangs te/ slar lha brag mched gsum gyi ru lag g.yu mtsho drag po mdangs ldan du mkha' 'gro'i brda yig bod du bsgyur ba'o//

item.tib: rig 'dzin gsang ba'i rgyud las gshin rje tshangs bzlog ral gri'i 'khor lo
item.coloph: bdag 'dra o rgyan bde chen gling pa mi 'gyur tshe dbang gsang sngags grags pa rtsal gyi (gyis) kong yul dbus phyogs yongs rdzogs dpal gyi phug nas drangs te slar lha brag mched gsum gyi ru lags g.yu mtsho drag po mdang ldan du mkha' 'gro'i brda yig bod du bsgyur ba'o//
